svg.text: • Scale/NFRs: 100M+ users, 10k+ TPS peak, < 200 ms for wallet-to-wallet, 99.99% availability, strict consistency for money, idempotent retries

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Never just UPDATE balance: keep an immutable double-entry ledger (debit and credit rows that sum to zero); balance = sum of entries, wallet balance is a reconciled cache

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Avoid deadlocks by locking rows in sorted id order. Hot wallets: batch incoming credits through Kafka and apply one aggregated credit
